Anomaly Detection

Statistical outlier detection across cost, payment pattern and financial-vs-physical progress mismatch, benchmarked against district/category peer groups.
Cost Anomalies
Sanctioned amount >50% above district+category median
Progress-Financial Mismatches
Fund utilization exceeds physical completion by >30 pts
Payment Anomalies
Unusual release/expenditure pattern detected
Anomaly TypeSeverityProjectLocationExpectedActualDeviationExplanation

Duplicate Work Detection

Projects with highly similar description, location, category, contractor and cost. Flagged as potential duplicate — requires verification, not confirmed misconduct.
